name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After § 33 – Am 21
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 33a. Expresses concern that the Agreement may accelerate delocalisation, particularly in the automotive sector, by incentivising the organisation of production around lower-cost assembly in Mexico; notes that existing EU-Mexico trade patterns already show EU manufacturers using Mexico as an assembly hub for final goods; warns that this model risks putting workers in the EU and Mexico in direct competition with one another, contributing to downward pressure on wages, employment and labour standards; calls on the Commission to ensure that EU trade policy actively supports and defends EU industrial capacity, quality employment and fair working conditions;
